EmailTemplate.subject: 5 Steps to Modernize Patient Payments
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Shifting to a more digitally focused, self-service strategy can be challenging if you don’t know where to start. Becker’s Hospital Review, recently tackled this issue in their article 5 strategies for healthcare providers to modernize their payment system. <[[https://www.beckershospitalreview.com/digital-transformation/5-strategies-for-healthcare-providers-to-modernize-their-payment-system.html?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>
If anything is certain, as we head into the back half of 2020, it’s that patients need providers to offer them affordable, self-service payment options. And providers need it too.
Many patients can’t afford to pay their bills in full and are still too afraid to go onsite even if they could. Meanwhile, the majority of financial staff has been shifted to remote locations, so there’s no one there to greet patients with valued services like financial counseling if they went in anyway.
Providers need to adapt quickly to meet patients where they are: in their homes.
Read the article to gain in depth, step-by-step advice <[[https://www.beckershospitalreview.com/digital-transformation/5-strategies-for-healthcare-providers-to-modernize-their-payment-system.html?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> on how to update your patient payments process from two of the largest health systems in the United States: AdventHealth and Banner Health.
Let us know what you think.
